outline: Projects/Tags replace the classification dropdown with expanded catalog hierarchy and exact-membership Actions; filters apply to Actions only. On hold remains visible. Unassigned/Untagged groups remain reachable.
identity: Catalog and Action inspector targets are discriminated by kind and UUID. Action occurrence keys contain catalog context. Tags may show the same Action UUID under several Tags; each occurrence has separate range highlight/focus while drafts/writes/Undo share Action identity.
selection: Plain occurrence click selects one; Shift selects the exact contiguous visible occurrence interval. Write IDs deduplicate and normalize in canonical Action order. Catalog headers are not selectable Action occurrences or drag destinations. Expansion/view/filter changes clear live occurrence range but preserve drafts and pending exact writes.
inspector: Action keeps existing fields. Project/Tag shows Name, Description and readonly parent path, with existing-catalog autosave. Empty catalog names are rejected. Later typing/IME/caret, external conflicts, deletion and exact unknown recovery are retained in a separate typed catalog draft namespace.
creation: Catalog selection is an inspector/Add context rather than a tree filter. New child uses existing get-or-create parent_id; Project/Tag create remains inline. No catalog drag, delete or new backend/storage contract.
proof: Pure tree hierarchy/exact-membership/occurrence tests, actual-service catalog normalized own baselines and unknown external-change tests, DOM range/inspector/IME tests and root browser/full gates.
